title: auditmysite technician finding row (one line of findings.jsonl)
description: findings.jsonl holds one JSON object per line, one line per finding occurrence on one page, uncapped (the per-page report stores at most a few occurrences per finding). Canonical English. See README 'Technician mode'.

source.description: wcag: WCAG rule violation. journey: keyboard/interaction journey finding. seo: heading-structure issue. html_conform: HTML5 conformance checker.

rule_id.description: wcag: taxonomy rule id, same as findings[].rule_id in the page report. journey: journey.<Kind>. seo: seo.headings.<issue>. html_conform: the checker's rule id.

wcag_criterion.description: WCAG success criterion such as 1.1.1; null outside wcag.

severity.description: Severity of this occurrence. html_conform maps the checker's error/warning/info to high/medium/low.

selector.description: CSS selector of the affected element, when known.

location.description: line:column in the rendered HTML (html_conform only).

viewport_tags.description: Which viewport pass saw the occurrence: mobile-only, desktop-only, both-viewports (wcag only; empty when not recorded).
